create_locomotion_gym_env: create a LocomotionGymEnv instance with a robot class, scene, sensors, and task for locomotion RL training
reset_locomotion_env: reset the LocomotionGymEnv to initial motor angles and return the initial observation dictionary
step_locomotion_env: step the LocomotionGymEnv forward with an action and return observation, reward, done, and info
render_locomotion_env: render the LocomotionGymEnv as an rgb_array or topdown view using pybullet camera matrices
set_time_step_locomotion_env: set the simulation time step and action repeat count for the LocomotionGymEnv physics engine
